hook.say: These five geography questions sound easy. They are not. Trust the map, not your gut!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Which of these cities is farthest north?
questions.fact: Rome sits at almost 42 degrees north, above New York, Madrid and Beijing.
questions.sayAnswer: Rome! It sits at almost 42 degrees north, above New York, Madrid and Beijing.

questions.q: Which country has the longest coastline in the world?
questions.fact: Canada has over 200,000 km of coast, counting its thousands of islands.
questions.sayAnswer: Canada! It has over 200,000 kilometers of coast, counting its thousands of islands.

questions.q: Which of these US cities is farthest west?
questions.say: Which of these U.S. cities is farthest west?
questions.fact: Reno, Nevada, is farther west than Los Angeles, on the Pacific coast.
questions.sayAnswer: Reno! This Nevada city is farther west than Los Angeles, which sits on the Pacific coast.

questions.q: At their closest, how far apart are Russia and the United States?
questions.fact: Russia's Big Diomede and Alaska's Little Diomede are about 4 km apart.
questions.sayAnswer: About 4 kilometers! That is the gap between Russia's Big Diomede island, and Alaska's Little Diomede.

questions.q: With which country does France share its longest land border?
questions.fact: French Guiana, part of France, shares a 730 km border with Brazil.
questions.sayAnswer: Brazil! French Guiana in South America is part of France, and shares a 730 kilometer border with Brazil.
